Privacy Policy

Updated July 8, 2026

What We Collect

If you sign up for our newsletter, we collect your email address. That's it. We don't ask for your name, address, phone number, or anything else. The email is stored securely and used only to send you the newsletter you signed up for.

We do not use tracking cookies, analytics scripts, or any form of user tracking. When you click an Amazon affiliate link, Amazon may set their own cookies as part of their standard referral program — that's outside our control.

How We Use Your Data

  • Your email: Only for sending the newsletter you subscribed to
  • No selling, no sharing, no third-party data transfers
  • No profiling, no behavioral tracking, no ads retargeting

Unsubscribe

Every newsletter email includes a one-click unsubscribe link. We honor it immediately — no questions, no delays.

Data Storage

Emails are stored in a SQLite database on a private server. We don't use third-party email platforms, cloud storage, or data processors for your information.

Contact

Questions? Reach out via our contact form or email us directly.

Changes

If this policy changes, we'll update the date above. Significant changes will be announced in the newsletter.
